quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield the right-of-way to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You must also always yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: To help prevent crashes, you should:

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.

questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers do something unexpected. Communicate with other drivers, bicyclists, and pedestrians by signaling when you slow down, stop, or change direction. Use your emergency signals or horn when needed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest you can legally drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, you should first:

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
questions.explanation: After finding a space, checking traffic, and signaling, stop next to the car in front of your desired space. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: Child restraints are required for:

options.text: Children under age four and/or weighing less than 40 pounds.
All children if the driver is their parent or guardian.
All children seated in the front seat.
All children under age six when airbags are not available.

questions.correctAnswerText: Children under age four and/or weighing less than 40 pounds.
questions.explanation: Children under age four and/or weighing less than 40 pounds must use an approved child safety seat. Children ages four to eight (or under 4'9" tall) must use a booster seat.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a merge is ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one.

questions.question: The most common color of warning signs is:
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. These signs alert you to unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: A "No stopping" sign means you may only stop (unless directed by a police officer) to:

options.text: Stop for less than five minutes.

questions.explanation: A "No stopping" sign means you can only stop to obey a traffic signal, follow a police officer's direction, or prevent a crash with another vehicle.

questions.question: You are coming to an intersection with a flashing yellow light. You should:

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Prepare to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and with caution. Look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: You must pull over to the edge of the road and let an emergency vehicle pass:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you from the other direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: You must pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights. It does not matter if the vehicle is behind you or coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: Triangular signs with the point facing down:

options.text: Tell you to yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell you to yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs with the point facing down are yield signs. Slow down and check for traffic. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first if it is safe. You can go when the road is clear.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street. An emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you. You must:

options.text: Drive to the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down and let it pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you on a one-way street, drive to the nearest roadside and stop.

questions.question: Before you start the car, you should:

options.text: Make sure only back seat passengers have seat belts on.
Make sure only adult passengers have seat belts on.
Make sure only child passengers have seat belts on.
Make sure all passengers have seat belts on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure all passengers have seat belts on.
questions.explanation: Before you start the car, buckle your seat belt and make sure all passengers buckle theirs too. This should be part of your routine every time you drive.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and vehicles on the other road go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: On a vertical traffic light, the correct order from top to bottom is:
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: If you see an animal on the road, you should:

options.text: Pass the animal as close as possible.

questions.explanation: Be very careful when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid scaring it.

questions.question: What is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down when you enter, speed up when you exit.
Keep the same speed throughout the curve.
Speed up when you enter, slow down when you exit.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when you enter, speed up when you exit.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve. Speed up slowly as you exit. Speeding up as you enter a curve makes it harder to control your car.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road you are on ends ahead.
You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to turn either right or left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a school zone is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and watch for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and watch for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot move out of your way, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: How far from a railroad crossing can you not park?
questions.explanation: Do not park within 50 feet of a railroad crossing. Park only in legal spots where other drivers can clearly see your vehicle.

questions.question: When can you pass a car on the right shoulder?

options.text: When the car in front is turning.
When the car in front is going too slowly.
When you don't see any pedestrians.

questions.explanation: Never drive off the road or onto the shoulder to pass another vehicle. You cannot pass on the right shoulder under any circumstances.

questions.question: Why shouldn't you follow cars too closely?

options.text: You may not see the road between the cars.
You may not have time to stop if the car in front slows or stops suddenly.
You may not see the other car's turn signals.
You may not see the other car's brake lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not have time to stop if the car in front slows or stops suddenly.
questions.explanation: If you follow too closely, you won't have enough time to stop if the car in front suddenly slows down or stops. This can cause a crash.

questions.question: Signs that warn about dangerous conditions are called:
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazardous conditions ahead. Follow warning signs for your safety. Ignoring them can cause an accident.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Construction workers are on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross the road ahead. Drive carefully and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill or downgrade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely. Then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection. You do not always need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is coming from another road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let other cars and pedestrians go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. When you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Most crashes happen because drivers do not see other cars or do something unexpected. Talk to other drivers on the road to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: When you see a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Be ready to stop if a train is nearby.
Find a way around any lowered gates.
Assume no trains are coming and drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is nearby.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing signs warn you that a train may be near. Obey all railroad crossing signs. Never go around barriers or ignore the warning.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed when roads are wet.
Keep your tires filled to the correct air pressure.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when your car slides on water between your tires and the road. Tires with low air pressure or worn tread increase hydroplaning risk. Speeding also increases the risk.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: Stress can affect your driving by:

options.text: Lowering your ability to focus on driving.
Decreasing your chances of an accident.
Making you fall asleep at the wheel.
Making you more aware of others around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lowering your ability to focus on driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions affect how well you drive. You may not drive well if you are very worried, excited, afraid, angry, or sad. Stress makes it hard to concentrate on driving. It is better to wait to drive than to drive when you are upset.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.
